body.name: calEovs
body.type: finite independent published restriction index set
body.def: \(\mathcal E_{\mathrm{OVS}}\) is the lexicographically first maximal linearly independent subcollection of all formal OVS rows indexed by \(c,c'\in\mathcal C_u^{\mathrm{OVS}}\) at every OVS post period \(u\).
body.role: deterministic basis of all published observable restrictions
